prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of Balloon — the lord of the Balloon House of the Hydrogen Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Hydrogen (H) to carry in her design and the scene: airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water. Palette: pale sky blue, white, silver, a faint violet flame, clear glass.
HOUSE TRAITS of Balloon: round gas envelopes, netting and mooring ropes, a wicker or brass gondola; buoyancy shown as hair and skirts lifting upward. Palette: cream canvas, pale blue, brass, rope tan.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: slender build; voluminous hair; cream-blonde hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face; large round eyes; thin arched brows; small button nose; small bow lips; sky-blue eyes.
WORLD — FANTASY: a kingdom floating above the clouds: sky islands tethered by ropes, drifting balloon-lanterns, a temple that keeps a star's pale fire, endless morning sky. COSTUME (fantasy): a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns. No corset, no bustle, no Victorian tailoring, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
SETTING (this card): on a sky island tethered by ropes, drifting balloon-lanterns around her.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
source: 생성기 조립 그대로 — 수소나라 풍선(기구) 가문주(2026-10-31, 사용자 「기구 가문주 이미지 생성 작업해줘」). 장면 변주로 근본·물 가문주와 배경을 갈랐다(하늘 섬 · 비행선 곤돌라 · 극저온 탱크)
